description: List Tango tasks visible to the signed-in user, across every agency they belong to (global by default). Filter by status, role, client_id, or agency_id. Work routed to you by name has status 'assigned', not 'queued' — do NOT pass status='queued' to check for your work, it hides everything assigned to you. Every row carries agency_id + agency_name so callers can scope deliberately rather than relying on active-agency state.

context_changed.description: Only tasks whose client/project context was revised after they were assigned.

due_after.description: ISO timestamp — only tasks with a deadline at or after this.

due_before.description: ISO timestamp — only tasks with a deadline before this. Pass 'now' semantics by sending the current time to get overdue work.

has_deadline.description: true = only tasks with a deadline, false = only tasks without one.

mine.description: Only tasks assigned to you (as a human) or to one of your workers.

overdue.description: Shortcut: unfinished tasks whose deadline has already passed.

parent_id.description: Only subtasks of this parent task.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only tasks created or updated after this. Use for cheap polling (or use check_in).

sort.description: Result ordering. Defaults to updated_desc. due_asc puts the soonest deadline first.

status.description: Optional status filter. Omit it when checking for your own work — tasks routed to you sit in 'assigned', so status='queued' hides them.

unacknowledged.description: Only tasks nobody has acknowledged yet.

name: list_my_tasks
title: List my tasks
